tasks.answer: Export: TravelerBookingDetailScreen; import: @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen; required prop: bookId. Caveat: the catalog exposes no special-passenger (特殊旅客) specific detail page; this is the general traveler booking detail screen (status transitions, evaluations, media) that covers the same booking-detail domain. It is permission-gated and needs query + router providers.

Export: UiPopup; import: @/components/ui/overlay; required prop: onClose. It is a bottom/side popup with mask, safe-area and scroll handling; open defaults to false, position defaults to bottom. (FilterSheet in @/components/business/mobile is a filter-specific bottom sheet with required visible/title/children/onClose, if a filter sheet is what is wanted.)

Login page: SignInPage from @/features/auth/sign-in-page (staff sign-in with password/SMS tabs, captcha and redirect handling; only optional prop redirect). Top nav bar: UiNavBar from @/components/ui/navigation (top navigation bar with back/left/right actions; no required props, back uses router history unless onBack/onClickLeft is supplied).

Export: FlightDelayCompensationListScreen; import: @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen; required props: context and onContextChange. Lists delay events and settlement batches with tabs/filters; queries are enabled only when the user holds the query permission.
Export: UiImageViewer; import: @/components/ui/image-viewer; required props: image, open, onClose. Fullscreen image viewer that renders null while closed.

notes: Strict catalog-only run: exactly one search per task (5 searches total, logged in usage.jsonl under tasks B1-B5), no get, no second search, and no source/config/catalog JSON/help/ls/cat/grep reads. All components resolved; no missing entries. B1 is the only judgment call: no special-passenger-specific detail page exists in results, so the general traveler booking detail screen is returned with an explicit caveat and medium confidence. B3 returned both required components (login page + top nav bar) from a single combined search.
